workflow: New native compositions generated with built-in image_gen; opaque room-like depth panoramas; lossless WebP, no geometric resizing.

prompts.name: portrait
prompts.prompt: Create a NEW production underwater background illustration for the Lavender Bay cozy farm fishing minigame. Use reference only for exact visual style, palette, soft rounded sandstone, creamy shell highlights, turquoise water, lavender and peach coral, honeylit upper-left rays. Preserve naturally rounded, undistorted shells/rocks/coral branches. This is an authored depth panorama, NOT a stretched resize of the reference. NO fish, hook, fishing line, float, UI or text. Empty central 68 percent is readable open water for gameplay; lovingly detailed coral/seaweed/stone ledges only at left/right margins. Top is sunny turquoise water near the surface, gradually becomes cooler blue-lavender toward bottom with subdued glows and a soft sandy floor at the very bottom. No horizon or hard transitions. Keep organic life-sized shell shapes, not giant huge props. Polished hand-painted bright joyful casual game, not photoreal. Opaque background. PORTRAIT SCROLLING CANYON, requested1024x3072 extremely tall, narrow natural composition. Staggered small rocky ledges and feathery kelp trace both edges, clear vertical water corridor. Compose as one long native tall painting with shallow upper half and deeper lower half, for vertical phones. Round shells and branching coral stay naturally proportioned.
